scope: Independent read-only client integration review by world/JEV lane; provider-free reproduction. All findings fixed before version6 packaging.

findings.issue: Server npc.cancel retained old turn and dropped later spontaneous arrival/timeout speech.
findings.fix: Mark canceled turn and release ownership, with regression.

findings.issue: Outer App audio unlock allowed a stale mic request after typed input.
findings.fix: Only startRecording owns unlock under epoch guard.

findings.issue: Replay lost mute while UI retained setting.
findings.fix: Apply current mute ref to new voice instance; reset transient replay state.

findings.issue: Resident kept walking in place after movement control release.
findings.fix: Send one zero-vector stop on release/keyup/blur; accept finite dt0 stop without displacement, with regression.

sourceChangedAfterReview: Only the documented fixes and evidence; production build passed.
